reflections.summary: The physical-heavy preview (Mega Metagross, Mamoswine, Meowscarada, Incineroar) won by exploiting the opponent’s lack of physical bulk, but it was poorly optimized for Houndoom’s Protect/Flash Fire stall and Sinistcha’s Matcha Gotcha spread, forcing reliance on Life Orb recoil and critical hits. Victory was secured through Incineroar’s Intimidate/Darkest Lariat cycling and priority cleanup rather than the intended Mega Metagross lead.
reflections.adjustment: Swap Mega Metagross for a faster special attacker or dedicated Fire-resistant pivot to bypass Houndoom’s Protect/Flash Fire stall and reduce dependency on physical priority/crits; lead with Incineroar + Meowscarada to immediately pressure Houndoom and Sinistcha before they set up.
reflections.notebook: Houndoom consistently uses Protect + Flash Fire + Focus Sash to stall physical attackers; break Sash early with multi-target/status. Sinistcha relies on Matcha Gotcha + Sitrus + Hospitality to sustain physical teams; Trick Room remains a threat if it returns. Blastoise-Mega is purely special-focused and vulnerable to physical priority. Opponent benches Drizzle/ThickFat, indicating preference for Trick Room or neutral weather. Preserve Incineroar Intimidate cycles. Darkest Lariat reliably ignores stat changes vs setup sweepers. Avoid overcommitting physical sweepers into Fire/Grass spreads; prioritize speed control or special threats to bypass Protect stall in future games.

reflections.notebook: Series lost 0-2 to p1-openrouter. Durable opponent tendencies: (1) Opponent runs Incineroar + Meowscarada pivot line — Incineroar Parting Shot into Meowscarada is a confirmed win condition; Meowscarada carries Life Orb Protean and will crit-pressure weakened Focus Sash users. (2) Mamoswine is the Thick Fat Sash cleaner with Rock Slide and Ice Shard priority — do not leave Fire-types exposed. (3) Metagross-Mega delays Mega Evolve to T6 and plays Protect-happy; not a T1 threat. (4) Hatterene Magic Bounce is held in reserve when Trick Room users are present — do not lead Sinistcha and Hatterene together. (5) Rotom-Heat is reserved for rain-weak matchups. Future plans: drop Blastoise-Mega from the pool against Incineroar/Meowscarada/Mamoswine cores; prioritize Sneasler Acrobatics or a Choice Scarf as the Meowscarada answer; keep Houndoom Sash intact by avoiding neutral hits from Mamoswine; open with Fake Out pressure to deny the Incineroar→Meowscarada pivot.
